*help break this here's the full example: https://github.com/Leibniz137/genesis-examples/tree/eip-1559/go-ethereum/eip-1559 8545 and 30303 are exposed in that example, so it should be possible to have other nodes peer with it and test various things that example only runs for 2h that testnet is a clean slate, so adding ropsten state for example would be more involved there could definitely be other nodes in the network, though they'd have to agree on a genesis state maybe coming up with a testplan is the first thing? it would be good too to get some feedback on network parameters like difficulty. vub wanted fast blocktimes to stress the network so we should make sure that is adequately handled gotcha i think the medium term intent is to fork the true ropsten to inclde this geth veresion but I imagine there would need to be very explicit reason for this given how many projects use it Maybe make a bot that sends transactions, with a FEECAP spread out across some range? would be good to see the basefee alive and floating or maybe even coordinated tx Raids lets do it as a livestream First step is the bot, second step is ICOs 🙂 if someone could fork ropsten and maintain a bootnode for it, then we could configure the whiteblock nodes to use that as the bootnode oh i see, actually fork ropsten for reals
